Speaker: Rip Tearson and cousins

New line: Maren says that's where they took your friend from the castle gate. I'd go down myself, but it feels like yours to open. Be careful, buddy.

Speaker: Old Man Mountain

New line: He laughed about it, too, sitting there on the mat with his little crown over one eye. Lovely boy. I wonder sometimes... no, never mind me. Old man talk. Where was I?

Speaker: Basil

New line: The real Chef baked a birthday cake for the little prince once. Four layers, one for each Path. He licked the frosting off all four and left the rest. ...Are you all right? You've gone pale.

Speaker: D.N.A. staff

New line: There was a third form, for the little prince, and I never filed it: no remains, no certificate. ...You've gone very still, dear. People only do that when the form is about them.

Speaker: Kyle
Current line: fun fact: ten years ago i was the one who filed the big transfer form. didn't read it, though. who reads forms?
New line: fun fact: ten years ago i filed the big transfer form. the peacock drafted it and handed it to me on my way to the rec room, so... a tuesday. didn't read it, though. who reads forms?

Speaker: (narration)

Speaker: Gerald, Number 4,000,212

Current line: My number's been called. I'm only here because I like the coffee.
New line: My number's been called. I asked Hob for one more pot before I go, and I'm making it last.

Speaker: Brother Bramble

New line: I water the twelfth spot anyway. I couldn't tell you why, except that it feels as if somebody is still coming. ...You're looking at it as if you've stood there before.

Speaker: Brother Bramble

New line: Forgive me. I talk to that spot more than I talk to most people. It's a very good listener, and it never tracks mud into the Grange.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
Current line: The raccoons saw it too. Raccoons see everything; they just won't tell you about it.
New line: The raccoons listen too, of course. Raccoons hear everything; they just won't tell you about it.

Speaker: Brother Bramble
When it's heard: Talking to Brother Bramble (return) (after the zone is freed)
Current line: Though NOBODY has explained who ate the compost. The raccoons have suddenly become excellent listeners.
New line: Nobody's apologised for the compost, mind. The raccoons have become excellent listeners and very poor confessors.

Speaker: Old Hob the Gravedigger (secretly Death)
When it's heard: Scene "hob town freed" (hob town freed), step 1
Current line: The intake's open again, did you hear? Busy week. Gerald's number finally came up, lovely chap, and he brought his own mug for the journey.
New line: The intake's open again, did you hear? Busy week. Gerald's number finally came up, lovely chap. He asked if he could stay on for one more pot first, and I said yes. No rush, in my line.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Current line: You knew me before all this.
New line: Everywhere I go, someone tells me a story about a little prince, then looks at me and stops talking. You knew me before all this, didn't you?

Speaker: The Wanderer
Current line: There's nothing to forgive. You gave me a bed and pie when you still thought I might be a spy.
New line: My mother called me across that courtyard. I can hear her voice now, and I still can't see her face. I'd like to, one day. I'd like to know what they were like.

Speaker: Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency
When it's heard: Scene "quota yards after" (quota yards after), step 3

New line: Detained. I have never been detained. I do not even know how long it takes.

Speaker: Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency

Speaker: Old Fern

New line: Granny Gristle needs hands on the compost rows down in the Dump, sorting peel from shell all day long. It's messy work, and you'd hate it. Good. It's yours if you want it.

Speaker: Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper
Current line: ...I shall bring my own gloves.

Speaker: The Wanderer

New line: I met a man who'd been locked up for ten years without a single weight, and he could still lift me off the floor. Strength is what you do with what's left, and strength is not control.

Speaker: The Wanderer

New line: You copied my cards, but what I do with them is mine. I watched a cook give her own name away and stay exactly herself, so I know a name's a blank page until you sign it.

New line: I spent ten years filed under 'subject'. Never again, not me and not anyone else. No order you could write outranks treating people with respect.

Speaker: Primm
Current line: I made... (he stops.) I made a list of things other people had already built, and I put my name on it.
New line: I made... (he stops.) I made them, and they were good. Then I put my name on every one, and I stopped asking anyone whether they wanted the next.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Current line: You kept every face and every house. Nothing grows if you refuse to let anything go.
New line: You kept every face and every house under glass. I've stood in a field where nothing was allowed to die, and nothing grows there either.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Current line: You took my mother and father, and I can't even remember their faces. I'm not going to keep that under glass the way you keep everything. I'm letting it go.
New line: You took my mother and father. Then you kept me behind glass for ten years, and every morning someone said 'again'. I remember that word better than I remember their faces.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Current line: You took my mother and father, and I can't even remember their faces. I'm letting it go anyway. Watch me.
New line: You took my mother and father. Then you kept me behind glass for ten years, and every morning someone said 'again'. I remember that word better than I remember their faces.

Speaker: Primm
Current line: ...(a long silence)... I made them smile. I made them all smile.
New line: ...(a long silence)... Your mother and father were sentimental people, and sentiment was going to cost this kingdom everything. I removed two people so that eleven thousand could be safe. I did the sums twice.

Speaker: Primm
Current line: And they smiled, and they smiled, and I looked at their faces, and I thought: they look like me. And I was so happy.
New line: And you, I looked after. You were fed at seven, at noon and at six, for ten years, and you were never once cold. Tell me which part of that was unkind. I should like it in writing.

Speaker: Primm
Current line: It was the mirrors, wasn't it? I wanted a world where nothing could ever surprise me.
New line: (You do not answer. He waits for a correction that does not come.) ...It was the mirrors, wasn't it? I wanted a world where nothing could ever surprise me.

New line: I'm not going to correct you; that was always your way. I'm not going to forgive you either, not today. Start smaller than a kingdom. Say sorry to one person.

Speaker: Primm
Current line: It is very heavy. It was always very heavy. And tell the Wrinkles... tell them I am sorry about the hats.
New line: It is very heavy. It was always very heavy. Tell the Wrinkles... tell them I am sorry about the hats. (He hears himself.) No. That is not the thing. I never learned how to say the thing.

Speaker: (narration)

New line: The scale model cracks in half, and then the table under it, and then, with the sound of a very large drawer being pulled from a very large cabinet, every locked door in the castle swings open at once.

New line: {villain} demanded one way for everyone. In the plaza, a Beefcake holds a ladder steady while a Necrocrat checks it against a form.

Speaker: (narration)

New line: A Gourmand passes up the hammer, and a Refusemancer catches the nail that falls, because it can still be used.

Speaker: (narration)
Current line: The point was never to be the same; the point was the argument. Different Paths, working together.
New line: Different Paths, working together, and arguing the whole time about where the sign should go. It goes up crooked, and it stays up.

Speaker: Primm
Current line: Your power has kept this kingdom lit for ten years, and I have only ever looked after it. Surely you can see that.
New line: Your power has kept the Paths in one shape for ten years, and I have only ever looked after it. Surely you can see that.

Speaker: (narration)
Current line: The castle does not fall; it opens. Where the Model Room floor was, a stair of four colours winds down into the old heart of the Capital.
New line: Under the Model Room the floor opens too, and a stair of four colours winds down into the old heart of the Capital.

Speaker: (narration)
Current line: Everything comes back at once: the lullaby, the glass, the throne room, the name. {prince_full}. And the Paths, all four, as they were always meant to be carried.
New line: The Throne says your name back to you, {prince_full}, and this time it brings the Paths with it, all four, as they were always meant to be carried.

Speaker: (narration)
Current line: '{prince},' she says. It is the first time anyone has said it aloud and meant it. 'Welcome home.'
New line: '{prince},' she says, loud enough for the whole plaza to hear. She has said it in her kitchen; this is the first time she has said it to the kingdom. 'Welcome home.'

Speaker: Primm, "His Perfection"

New line: Do not look so alarmed. The guard is very kind. Every morning he brings me the list of the people I corrected, and I read it. There are eleven thousand names. I am on the third page.

Speaker: (narration)
Current line: At the edge of the crowd, a hooded traveler smiles, leaves still in their hair. There is always another path.
New line: At the edge of the crowd you catch yourself looking for a hood with leaves caught in it, and not finding one. Not yet.

Speaker: (narration)
Current line: With {villain} gone, the Paths are free to mix again. Your decks may now combine cards from ALL Paths, and the Alchemist's tri-Path crafting is open. What made the kingdom strong was never sameness.
New line: With {villain} gone, the Paths are free to mix again. Your decks may now combine cards from ALL Paths, and the Alchemist's tri-Path crafting is open. And under the forest, someone is still waiting for you.
